plain: The taking away of something needed or owed.

webster.text: The act of depriving; a taking away.

example.quote: We fought then for what we are contending for now — to prevent an arbitrary deprivation of our property, contrary to ou. consent and inclination.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 9, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
